remarks: Timeless Colonial with Modern Comforts and River Views Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac, conveniently located close to town this beautiful updated 4 bedroom, 2 full and 2 half bath Colonial that seamlessly blends classic charm with modern convenience. The open floor plan enhances the sense of space, while oversized windows fill the home with natural light. The heart of the home is the updated kitchen, featuring stainless steel appliances, a center island with breakfast bar, and easy flow into the formal dining room making it ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The formal living room with fireplace adds warmth and sophistication. A powder room and fourth bedroom or office complete the first floor. Upstairs, the primary suite features high ceilings, 2 large walk-in closets, and a private bath. Two additional bedrooms share a well-appointed hall bath. The finished walk-out lower level offers even more living space, complete with a fireplace, half bath, and room for a media area, home gym, or playroom. Step outside to a deck overlooking the Five Mile River, where nature provides the perfect backdrop for relaxation or gatherings. Recent updates include a new roof, driveway, new garage doors, central AC, two renovated half baths, walkways, doors, and updated landscaping. A generator provides year-round peace of mind.
